snippet.title: v8.8 Adrift in the Sea of Data Trailer - Honkai Impact 3rd
snippet.description:
Honkai Impact 3rd v8.8 "Adrift in the Sea of Data" is coming soon! Stay tuned for main story Part 2 Chapter XII: With You, Whom I Never Knew, featured event "Project Sea of Data: Thesis Crisis", and a new outfit drop!
